title: Hotel Relocations and the Return of Free Night Awards
content:
When the hotel relocates a Reward Night Rate reservation, every award on it comes back to the member's account, and its return record states the walked-night protected price: the points price at which the walked night stays protected for the member.

The return record of one of the Free Night Awards coming back from a reservation the hotel relocated states the walked-night protected price, as the Free Night Awards terms work it out, rather than repeating the price recorded on the hold.

An award that comes back from a relocated stay after its expiry date has passed stands returned in the member's account, usable for no stay, so that its replacement can be deposited against it; the system's own expiry run then closes it as expired, and it is never reinstated for a new stay.

A relocated reservation is one the hotel walked to another hotel because it could not honour it; the reservation record shows it as relocated, with the relocation date.

## Situation of use and capability

`release_relocated_award_8143384d` returns to the member's account a Free Night Award that was on a reservation the hotel relocated (walked). It puts one award back: the award's status becomes issued again, the award keeps its reservation and night as history and keeps its original expiry date, and one return entry is added to the award's history naming the award, the relocated reservation and night, the walked-night protected price given in the call, no top-off points, the current date and the reason that the reservation was relocated. Afterwards the award stands returned in the member's account, keeping its original expiry date, and the return appears in its history.

## How it is invoked

An agent-side tool: unlock it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, then call it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, naming `release_relocated_award_8143384d`.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `certificate_id` | The reference number of the Free Night Award being returned, read from the member's award records | Identifier |
| `reservation_id` | The reference number of the relocated reservation the award comes back from, read from the member's reservation records | Identifier |
| `award_points_price` | The walked-night protected price the return entry states | Integer points: whole points, no decimals, never negative |

## Return

On success: a text rendering of a dictionary with `activity_id` (the reference number of the new return entry), `certificate_id` (the award returned), `status` (always `issued` on success), `activity_date` (the date of the return, YYYY-MM-DD) and `award_points_price` (the integer points recorded on the return entry). Receiving this dictionary means the award is back in the member's account.
